messages:
Ava Morgan: Heads-up — BrightLeaf (BL-231) reported an embed-count gap on INV-2026-042 after an AZ failover at ~03:12 UTC. They say ~1.7k missing. Asking for provisional credit + backfill. @Ravi @Sofia
Ravi Patel: do we know if those were lost in ingestion or collapsed by the rate-limiter? rough $ impact?
Ava Morgan: quick calc: expected 18,942 vs stored 17,210 = 1,732 missing. Pricing $0.20 / 1k -> ~$0.35 credit. Query I ran:
```
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as observed
FROM embeddings_store
WHERE customer_id = 'BL-231' AND created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY customer_id;
```
Joel Chen: infra says AZ failover caused client retries and our ip-based rate limiter had a 15s dedupe window that collapsed retries into one. We've shortened the dedupe window. Need a cluster-wide scan for that time window to find other affected customers. Ava please open infra-oncall ticket.
Sofia Li: Finance suggested GL-4420, memo: "Credit - embed undercount - INV-2026-042 - BrightLeaf". Proposed adjustment text:
"Credit $0.35 to BrightLeaf (BL-231) for 1,732 missing embeddings. Root cause: AZ failover + rate limiter dedupe. Ticket FIN-3892."
FinOps Bot: Created ticket FIN-3892: "BrightLeaf embed undercount during AZ failover" assigned to Ava Morgan. https://redwood.atlassian.example/browse/FIN-3892
Ravi Patel: provisional approve :white_check_mark: pending infra cross-customer scan. Run a cluster-wide query for 03:00-03:30 UTC and post results.
Ava Morgan: will run the scan, apply a provisional negative line on the invoice now, and follow up with a backfill if replay finds rows. Sofia please prepare GL entry and hold final close until scan done.
Sofia Li: ack — will prepare GL entry and post ledger id when recorded.
Ava Morgan: leaving this thread for audit trail.
